title: PISim: A Unified Photonic Inference Simulator for Hardware-Aware Cross-Layer Design-Space Exploration
abstract: arXiv:2611.16522v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Photonic neural accelerators offer ultra-low latency linear algebra, yet their usable numerical precision, sustainable throughput, and application accuracy remain tightly bounded by surrounding electro-optical interfaces and physical non-idealities. Pre-fabrication design-space exploration (DSE) requires a cross-layer electronic design automation (EDA) framework capable of evaluating disparate optical topologies under identical neural workloads and physical assumptions. translated_title: PISim：面向硬件感知跨层设计空间探索的统一光子推理模拟器
translated_abstract: 光子神经加速器能够提供超低延迟的线性代数运算，然而其可用的数值精度、可持续吞吐量与应用精度仍受到周边电光接口和物理非理想性的严格制约。制造前的设计空间探索（DSE）需要一个跨层电子设计自动化（EDA）框架，能够在相同的神经网络工作负载和物理假设下评估不同的光学拓扑结构。我们提出了 PISim——一个统一的光子推理模拟器，它将预训练深度神经网络的执行与基于物理的模型相耦合，涵盖六种加速器架构系列、六种电光调制器技术、四种光学光源组织方式，以及直接或相干读出方案。PISim 内嵌了按阶段解析的损伤算子——涵盖控制与模数转换量化、有限消光比、散粒噪声、相关相对强度噪声等（摘要原文在此处截断）。
tldr: PISim 是一个统一的光子推理模拟器，它将预训练深度神经网络执行与涵盖六种加速器架构、六种电光调制器技术、四种光源组织方式及直接/相干读出方案的物理模型相耦合，从而支持制造前的硬件感知跨层设计空间探索。
en_tdlr: PISim is a unified photonic inference simulator that couples pretrained deep neural network execution with physics-based models of six accelerator architecture families, six electro-optic modulator technologies, four optical source organizations, and direct/coherent readout schemes, enabling hardware-aware cross-layer design-space exploration before fabrication.
